filter.health_condition: Germfree Cesarean-derived piglets humanized with infant fecal microbiota

projects.intervention_detail: Oral inoculation of germfree piglets with pooled rural (Amish) or urban (non-Amish) infant fecal microbiota (RIFM or UIFM), mixed with 40 ml sterile infant milk formula, given at 2, 3, and 4 weeks of age; piglets euthanized at 7 weeks of age

papers.title: Amish (Rural) vs. non-Amish (Urban) Infant Fecal Microbiotas Are Highly Diverse and Their Transplantation Lead to Differences in Mucosal Immune Maturation in a Humanized Germfree Piglet Model.
Impact of Microbiota Transplant on Resistome of Gut Microbiota in Gnotobiotic Piglets and Human Subjects.
